audit_member_text: The vorticity correction uses imported identifier b2 at L460-L461 while neighboring dispersion coefficients use Beta_1 and Beta_2 throughout L292-L454. The definition and units of b2 are outside this file, so the apparent name change cannot be adjudicated from this source alone.

base_member_text: U4/V4 가 CARTESIAN 블록(L292-316)과 ZALPHA 블록(L318-325)에서 이중 정의될 수 있음(두 매크로 동시 정의 시 ZALPHA 가 덮어씀) — 배타성 보장은 빌드 시스템 소관으로 미확정
audit_member_text: CARTESIAN U4/V4 are assigned and may receive Gamma2 corrections at L291-L316; the separate ZALPHA block then assigns U4/V4 again at L318-L325. If CARTESIAN and ZALPHA can both be defined, the second block silently discards the Gamma2 additions. Mutual exclusivity of these preprocessor symbols is not enforced or documented here.

base_member_text: 교차라인: DU/DV·ETAT 루프는 J=1,Nloc-1·I=1,Mloc-1 (L103-104)인데 바로 위 주석 L111 은 'ykchoi pointed a bug: J=1,Nloc, I=1,Mloc' — 버그 지적이 코드에 반영되지 않은 상태(마지막 행·열 미계산)인지 이 파일만으로 미확정
audit_member_text: Range/assignment inconsistency: local DU and DV and GLOBAL ETAT are assigned only in loops J=1:Nloc-1 and I=1:Mloc-1 at L102-L118. The source comment at L110 explicitly says the corrected bounds are J=1,Nloc and I=1,Mloc, but the code still uses the shortened ranges. DU/DV are immediately passed to derivative routines over Ibeg:Iend,Jbeg:Jend at L149-L156 and their derivative results are consumed over the full 1:Mloc,1:Nloc loop at L289-L380; ETAT is later consumed at L415-L418. Unless caller/global initialization supplies the omitted last row and column and all stencil halos, these paths read stale or undefined values.

audit_member_text: The file documents that Ut and Vt should be evaluated outside the Runge-Kutta loop and that the current placement may affect hot starts at L124-L126, yet computes them locally from U-U0 over DT at L131-L140. The call site's RK and restart ordering is not present, so the magnitude and phase error cannot be resolved here.

Physical-edge blocks zero Uxy/DUxy/Vxy/DVxy and also Utxy/DUtxy/Vtxy/DVtxy at L193-L284, whereas the time-derivative arrays are computed only for CARTESIAN Gamma2>ZERO at L158-L179. Whether all those GLOBAL arrays are always allocated and initialized in other build modes is not established in this file.

All derivative calls rely on stencil accesses beyond Ibeg:Iend/Jbeg:Jend, but this routine's local DU/DV/DUt/DVt arrays have no explicit initialization outside their assignment loops and no halo exchange before the calls at L149-L178. The required halo ownership and ordering contract must be checked in callers and exchange routines.
